desc.collision.label: Collision
desc.collision.text: Room collision type. 0=single layer, 1=both layers active, 2=both+scroll, 3=moving floor, 4=water/swim.
desc.doorway.label: Doorway
desc.doorway.text: The doorway the player occupies, and the door animation step (0-16). Both are latched, so neither says what is happening right now.
desc.mode.label: Mode
desc.mode.text: Whether the player is currently indoors (dungeon/cave/house) or outdoors on the overworld.
desc.type.label: Type
desc.type.text: The type of interior: Dungeon (palace index 0-13, has maps/keys/bosses), or Cave/House (palace 0xFF, standalone interiors with no dungeon logic).
desc.room.label: Room
desc.room.text: The current room ID in the indoor tilemap (0x0000-0x0127). Each indoor room is a 512×512 pixel area.
desc.gridpos.label: Grid Pos
desc.gridpos.text: The room's position in the dungeon's 5×5 map grid for the current floor, as 1-based row,col. Caves and houses use the 16×16 room grid.
desc.floor.label: Floor
desc.floor.text: The current dungeon floor, with the range of all floors in this dungeon from highest to lowest.
desc.lastentrance.label: Last Entrance
desc.lastentrance.text: The entrance the player last used from the overworld. Does not update for indoor-to-indoor transitions.
desc.palaceindex.label: Palace Index
desc.palaceindex.text: Which dungeon the player is in (0-13). 0xFF = cave or house.
desc.startinglayer.label: Starting Layer
desc.startinglayer.text: The layer the player was on when this room was first entered. In rooms with staircase type 2 (Blocked), the player stays locked to it.
desc.viewport.label: Viewport
desc.viewport.text: Camera viewport of this room (width × height in screens). 'open' = no internal scroll boundaries. 'scroll' = camera scrolls between quadrants.
desc.effectivelayout.label: Effective Layout
desc.effectivelayout.text: How many cells the room occupies on the dungeon map grid.
desc.layer.label: Layer
desc.layer.text: The player's current collision layer. 0=Upper/BG2, 1=Lower/BG1. Staircases can change it.
desc.screen.label: Screen
desc.screen.text: The overworld screen index (0x00-0x3F). Grid position: row = upper bits, col = lower bits. Each screen is 512×512 pixels.
desc.world.label: World
desc.world.text: Light World or Dark World. The two 8×8 overworld grids occupy the same coordinate space but are separate maps.
desc.playerpos.label: Player Pos
desc.playerpos.text: The player's world position in pixels, relative to the room origin indoors and the overworld origin outdoors.
desc.worldpos.label: World Pos
desc.worldpos.text: The player's full world coordinates in pixels (same as Player Pos for outdoor). Used to calculate which overworld screen the player is standing on.
desc.relative.label: Relative
desc.relative.text: The player's position relative to the current 512×512 screen/room origin in pixels.
desc.subtile.label: Sub-tile
desc.subtile.text: The 8×8 tile range the player's hitbox currently overlaps. Row and column are in tile coordinates (0-63 per screen).
desc.map16.label: Map16
desc.map16.text: The 16×16 metatile coordinate the player occupies. Map16 tiles are the collision unit. Each contains four 8×8 sub-tiles.
desc.livescreen.label: Live Screen
desc.livescreen.text: The overworld screen the player is physically standing on right now (may differ from the 'Screen' in Game State during scrolling transitions).
desc.phase.label: Phase
desc.phase.text: The game's progress indicator byte. Controls NPC dialogue, event triggers, and overworld tile patches. Advances as you complete key objectives.
desc.tilepatch.label: Tile Patch
desc.tilepatch.text: Whether this screen has an active event overlay that modifies walkable tiles (e.g. rocks removed after an event).
desc.flags.label: Flags
desc.flags.text: Screen-specific event flags from SRAM. Track permanent world changes like opened chests, pulled levers, and destroyed barriers.
desc.npcblockers.label: NPC Blockers
desc.npcblockers.text: Number of sprites currently blocking BFS pathfinding (tutorial guards, barriers). These physically prevent the player from passing.
desc.staircase.label: Staircase
desc.staircase.text: 0=intra-room stairs (layer+room shift), 1=layer stairs (changes allowed), 2=pseudo/water stairs (layer changes blocked).
